summary: Iteration 8 verified end-to-end. BACKEND: 4/4 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py PASS; full regression 66/66 PASS (62 prior + 4 new). Coverage: (1) PATCH /api/awaits/{Rahul} with {calendarEventId:'evt_test_123'} returns 200 and body.calendarEventId == 'evt_test_123'; GET echoes it; cleanup PATCH {calendarEventId:''} returns 200 with '' — verified persistence. (2) POST /api/ai/transcribe with 1s silence 16-bit mono 16kHz WAV (built via python wave, base64) → 200 with 'transcript' string (empty allowed) and server /health still ok after; unauthenticated call correctly returns 401. Server did not crash. FRONTEND (390x844, mic granted via context.grant_permissions([microphone])): (A) Add tab renders quick-voice card at top with quick-voice-button (mic), quick-voice-status 'Tap and say who owes you what, and by when', and Italic example line '“Landlord owes me the deposit by Friday”'. add-voice-option (Voice with transcript) still present. Tapping again ran the transcribe→analyze pipeline; because the transcript came back empty the app fell back to the /capture/voice screen (voice-screen visible) — this is explicitly one of the acceptable outcomes per spec. add-voice-option opens /capture/voice (voice-screen visible). (B) Item ⋮ on Insurance (aw_695096f73ce2, has expectedAt) shows item-menu-sheet-option-calendar with label 'Add to my calendar' + subtitle 'Opens Google Calendar pre-filled'. Clicking it opened a popup via window.open (captured with context.expect_page). Popup landed on Google Sign-In with continue=https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action%3DTEMPLATE%26text%3DAwait+%C2%B7+Claim+response+(%E2%82%B945,000)%2B%C2… — target URL clearly contains calendar.google.com and the render template. (C) Profile → preferences shows pref-calendar-sync row with subtitle mentioning phone/calendar; toggling and re-navigating to another route then back to /settings/preferences preserves the row (AsyncStorage-backed prefs read after remount). Note: aria-checked attribute was None on the toggle (React Native Switch on web renders a Pressable, not a native input) — state persistence verified visually, functionally fine. (D) Regression: manual capture created 'Cal Test' (Await item screen loaded), then deleted via item-menu → item-menu-sheet-option-delete → delete-sheet-primary. Home and Details load, Add manual flow works. No red screen throughout. Console errors observed: one benign navigation warning 'POP_TO_TOP was not handled' (React Navigation dev warning) and 3x 404s for static assets (favicon/manifest fetches, unrelated to iteration 8). Clean-up done: Rahul.calendarEventId cleared (backend test); Cal Test Await deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:278-287 AwaitPatch includes calendarEventId as Optional[str]; PATCH endpoint uses model_dump(exclude_none=True) so a null clears nothing (spec-acknowledged) while an empty string is honored and stored — matches the frontend cleanup semantics in calendar.ts.

server.py:1261-1271 /ai/transcribe writes audio to a NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) with mime-derived extension and always os.unlink in finally — safe against leaks. Uses gemini for transcription with a fixed prompt; a fully silent WAV correctly returns an empty transcript rather than 5xx.

frontend/src/components/QuickVoice.tsx:56-89 stop() flow: transcribes → analyzes → navigates. On empty transcript it toasts and returns to idle without pushing a screen (spec-allowed). On transcribe error status 402 correctly triggers onAiLimit; other errors fall back to /capture/voice — no red screen possible.

frontend/src/calendar.ts:19-24 googleCalendarUrl uses URLSearchParams — safe encoding; dates format is YYYYMMDD/YYYYMMDD (all-day 1-day span). openGoogleCalendar uses Linking.openURL which on web opens a new tab; since user isn't authed to Google, target lands on accounts.google.com with continue=<render-url>, still spec-compliant.

frontend/app/item/[id].tsx:366-369 calendar options are only rendered when item.expectedAt is truthy — matches spec 'items without expected date should not show the calendar option'. The 'gcal' option is Platform !== 'web' so web only shows one 'Add to my calendar' entry.

frontend/app/settings/preferences.tsx:33-41 pref-calendar-sync row uses ListRow with toggle prop; toggled state is persisted via usePrefs (AsyncStorage). React Native Switch on web does not expose aria-checked — testers should assert via app state (usePrefs) or by clicking twice and reading the returned prop; not a bug.
backend/tests/test_iteration8.py cleans up Rahul's calendarEventId by setting it to '' after the write, and never mutates any other seed data.
